name: Fresh Ripe Papaya Slices
whyItWorks: Ripe papaya naturally contains papain, a proteolytic digestive enzyme that helps break down proteins and soothe gastric discomfort. The vibrant orange flesh is buttery soft and very easy on compromised intestines.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Scoop out and completely discard all black peppery seeds. Peel the skin cleanly and slice the buttery flesh into tender bite-sized cubes.
watchOuts: Never eat the black seeds, which are peppery and mechanically abrasive.
